planets.name: IRAS 04125+2902 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of IRAS 04125+2902 with a 8.83-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: IRAS 04125+2902 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around IRAS 04125+2902. Its orbit and size follow Barber et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BARBER_ET_AL__2024): disc_year 2024, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 8.834978, pl_radj 0.958, pl_bmassj 0.254

quotes.title: IRAS 04125+2902 b
quotes.card: IRAS 04125+2902 b, also known as TIDYE-1b, is an extremely young exoplanet orbiting the young protostar IRAS 04125+2902 approximately 520 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Taurus.
quotes.introduction: It is the youngest transiting exoplanet so far discovered, with an age of just three million years.
